column1: # The BIM4LCA office files that Measure reads with `-f nordic=true` (#763): the concrete structure
# as built and at building permit, and (#1262) the terrain variants at building permit in concrete
# and timber, each with Revit's own IFC export, from VTT's ARCH.zip under CC BY-SA 4.0
# Read by byte range by tools/ci/fetch-bim4lca.py and never stored; same format as
# research/bim4lca-models.tsv, whose archive row this repeats. Entries measured 2026-10-18.
# A mirror row names another URL that serves the same archive, tried before the archive's
# own: the CDN that URL redirects to (2026-10-29), added after the first host timed out on the
# runners. The terrain entries were measured 2026-11-03 through the range reader.
